column1: # One row per source, tab-separated:  src <TAB> expected
# A line is a COMMENT only when it starts with '#' AND contains no tab, so a
# source may itself begin with '#' (boru's comment marker) without vanishing.
# EVERY column is escaped (\n, \t, \\) so a row is exactly one line. A render
# can itself contain a newline — XML text spanning lines does — and an
# unescaped one splits the row and silently truncates it rather than failing.
# `expected` is the canon of the parsed value stream (each value rendered,
# space-joined), or 'ERR ' and the first line of the error text. Both engines
# parser/ts/src/parserspec.test.ts read these files with NO shared code, the
# Rows the two engines DISAGREE on are not here — they are in divergent.tsv
# with both renders, so this file stays one contract rather than a lowest
# Seeded from parser/go. parse-battery.test.ts named it the reference while
